messages:
Adele (CS): Montclair onboarding — need UK + EU egress pin and a temporary QPS bump for an integration demo tomorrow. They require traffic to originate in eu-west for data residency. Can we provision an allowlist + region pin? IPs below.

Marc (NetOps): What IP ranges and duration are we looking at? Do they need mTLS or header pinning?

Adele (CS): IPs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.44 (integration runner). Backend cluster may also use 198.51.100.0/24. Duration: 72h with auto-revoke. QPS bump: 50 -> 300 for a demo window 09:00-12:00 UTC. They're on Hosted (enterprise). FYI renewal flagged — demo outcome affects renewal conversation.

Sam (SRE): OK. We'll need a routing rule to force eu region (serve eu model variant / eu-egress). I'll pre-warm KV cache before the window. Any secrets/HSM requirements?

Adele (CS): No HSM, standard API keys. I'll create a short-lived key named montclair-demo-eu (will expire).

Jen (Oncall): Temp QPS bump + allowlist is fine from oncall as long as it's autorevoked and monitored. I'll set TTL = 72h and attach an autorevoke policy. @Marc can you schedule the change in next 30m? :calendar: 

Marc (NetOps): Ack. I'll create firewall + routing tag and push during a low-impact slot at ~20:15 UTC. Posting rollback plan here once ready. Need owner to confirm test key before cutover.

ProvisionBot: Ticket created CS-8421: Montclair — EU allowlist + qps bump + region pin. Assigned: netops. ETA: ~20m.

Adele (CS): Confirmed. I'll upload the demo key to #secure-shared after the change and notify the customer. Adding a note to renewal tracker: smooth demo => potential upsell/annual commit.

Sam (SRE): I'll add tracing + cost guardrail to limit runaway usage. Suggested alerts: 5xx > 1% or QPS > 600.

Marc (NetOps): Deployed the rules, auto-revoke set to 72h. Monitoring hooks enabled. Rollback steps: remove routing tag + revoke demo key (manual if needed).

Adele (CS): Amazing — thank you all. I'll run enablement at 09:30 UTC and will post a recap + customer feedback afterwards. :rocket:
